rss: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
title: Kids' Online Marketplace Ban
story: The government is thinking about stopping kids from using certain online marketplaces. They want to make sure kids are safe and not buying things they shouldn't.
storyBig: Officials are considering a ban on children under 16 from accessing specific online marketplaces. The decision is aimed at ensuring the safety of younger internet users by regulating where they can make purchases.
think: Why do you think it's important for kids to be safe online?
bull: Banning certain platforms might keep kids safer.
bear: Kids might miss out on fun and learning opportunities.

rss: Labubu hype seemed unstoppable, now the fluffy monster mania is dying
title: Fluffy Toy Craze Fizzling Out
story: Lots of kids loved the fluffy toy monsters, but now fewer people are buying them. The company is seeing less money because the craze is fading away.
storyBig: The hype around the fluffy collectible monsters has significantly decreased, leading to a decline in sales for the company. The waning interest in these toys is impacting company revenue.
think: Why do you think some toy fads don't last very long?
bull: It's a chance to try new and exciting toys!
bear: The company might struggle if sales keep dropping.
